description_en: Queries the list of rules in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的规则列表
name: ListAggregateConfigRules

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:
ACTIVE: The rule is being applied.
DELETING: The rule is being deleted.
EVALUATING: The rule is being evaluated.
INACTIVE: The rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则运行状态。取值：
ACTIVE：应用中。
DELETING：删除中。
EVALUATING：评估中。
INACTIVE：已停用
parameters.name: config_rule_state

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result of the rule. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
parameters.help_zh:
规则合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2: medium risk.
3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The ID of the compliance package
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The keyword for the query.

Fuzzy match is supported for the rule ID, rule name, rule description, and rule template identifier
parameters.help_zh:
查询关键字。

支持对规则ID、规则名称、规则描述和规则模板标识等进行模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The resource type evaluated by the rule
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: By default, no value is passed. Currently supported: `CreateDate-Desc`, which sorts rules by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 默认不传值。当前支持：`CreateDate-Desc`，代表新创建的规则排序靠前
parameters.name: sort_by

规则合规评估的摘要结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

Count.description_en: The number of evaluated resources that correspond to the compliance evaluation summary result
Count.description_zh: 规则评估摘要结果对应的评估资源数

ConfigRuleState.description_en:
